main_body: Leafy tree canopy (rows ~0-29) on a thin brown trunk (rows 30-43) with a dark green grass base patch
top_band: Canopy: lighter green clumps at the top of each lobe (rows ~2-12), the dome reads as a volume lit from above, with darker green underside rows ~24-29; no flat horizontal slab
evidence: Organic tree: the canopy is a rounded mass with lighter highlighted tops and darker undersides casting shade onto the trunk top, and the trunk and ground patch stand below. It is not an architectural elevation and has no receding side face. The lit top of the canopy and darker lower foliage read as a 3/4 rounded volume. Treated as acceptable for an organic object.

style.evidence: The outline is a dark green tint next to the leaves, which is good. The canopy has about 4 green steps with some clump variation, but the lobes are smooth blobs with fewer leaf-level dots than the references. The trunk is a flat 3-tone brown column, about 4px wide and 14px tall, with only a vertical stripe. The base patch is nearly flat dark green. Next to the references, which have leaf-edge clumps, serrated silhouettes and root flare, this looks smoother and thinner, and the trunk and base carry little texture.
